integration_decision: Replace generic expanded command text with dedicated shell/output presentation only after constructor geometry and follow-state mutation gates are established.

findings.conclusion: Shell body composition includes CommandExecutionOutputScrollView, selectable Text, VStack/HStack, background and rounded-rectangle stroke.

Output scroll component fields include text/color/insets/min-max height, parsed text, content height, viewport size, following/user-scrolling flags, ScrollPosition and bottom offset; body0x1a67170 binds scroll geometry and phase callbacks.

Finite scroll geometry bottom=max(contentHeight-containerHeight+bottomInset,-topInset). Near-bottom predicate compares offsetY>=bottom-8. This does not yet prove when follow state changes or when scrolling is issued.
